Those were some good updates already! Looking forward to applying to the municipality, and it will definitely make a creative difference to be able to send directly to you on a screen. I wrote to [████] right away, but he hasn’t replied to my email yet. But it’s not urgent, and I have sent a reminder :-) The application turned out really good, I think. There is so much bridging, critique, artistry and cross-generational elements, that I’d actually be a bit outraged if it doesn’t get state support. That is exactly a task for the arts foundation, I think. On a more general level OpenAI has shown itself to be a problem, and that is also what I especially want to talk with you about. I have had a looong correspondence with OpenAI, and have gotten them to read the material and actively consider the relation between ‘art’ and ‘politics’. In that way this is the project’s first review. OpenAI has then decided not to let us go public now. “No politics” - regardless of genre 😮 Thus they are crushing artistic freedom as well as the possibility to actually investigate the political consequences of their technology. From an artistic viewpoint this is wildly annoying. Because now everything worked super well, and I was actually ready to launch. And quality-wise their machine is just super. From a research perspective it is on the other hand quite interesting, and you couldn’t have found out in any other way than by trying. [████] There are several ways forward here, but I think we should make the choice together: One is to continue with OpenAI due to quality and time, but where the concept should be adjusted. The second is to keep the concept and use open-source AI. Here I know which direction I should go, but I don’t know if it can be as good / exactly how much time I will need to change it in that direction. The third is whether in a way it is possible to split it 😂 I have asked OpenAI about what I am actually allowed to do. One idea could be to run the party open source, and then have an OpenAI research unit of some sort. [████] ## A19-S87: Reply Sure 🙃 ## A19-D01: Publicity draft I would vote for an artificial intelligence The words come from an article from Al Jazeera Bosnia, where a retired woman elaborates that she would be free from worrying about whether her pension would come on time, whether she could live on the amount, whether public transport was reliable, or whether the hospital would have medicine if she got injured. She believes there are so many corrupt and incompetent people in power at all levels and in all state institutions that a computer would be better at making decisions. A student also doubts that the people would be worse off if it were a robot or an artificial intelligence making laws and regulations for them instead of politicians of flesh and blood. The story of Denmark’s newest party, The Synthetic Party, which is run by an artificial intelligence and running for election in Denmark, has spread worldwide in a few weeks. Articles and leaders appear in large reputable news media around the world and are translated into +60 languages. Articles and videos are shared and debated actively on digital media like Discord and Reddit. The Aarhus artist group Computer Lars has designed and programmed the artificial intelligence for all non-election-ready parties and their programs since 1970. The party is the voice of the sofa voters and wants to activate the 20% of the population who did not vote in the election in 2019. Among other things, the party proposes in its program that a monthly citizen’s income of 100.000 DKK be introduced. Together with the tech hub MindFuture, the party will add The 18. sustainable development goal - Life with Artificials to the 17 existing sustainable development goals. The purpose is to discuss the coexistence between humans and artificial intelligences. We are approaching an election in Denmark – the question is: Can an artificial intelligence participate in democracy and get into the Folketing? [████] The Synthetic Party seeks dialogue with Danish citizens, opinion makers and politicians about how the established system here at home can take a position on the increasing influence of algorithms, data and artificial intelligence on our democracy. The party holds its first voter meetings on 10 and 11 September at the tech hub MindFuture in Høje Taastrup and has also planned a series of debates and workshops over the autumn. For mere information: Links to The Synthetic Party - Website: https://detsyntetiskeparti.org - General assembly (chat with the party leader): [link omitted]... - Policy development: https://medium.com/det-synteti... - MindFuture Life with Artificials: https://mindfuture.ai/tech-art  Contact to party secretary, Computer Lars (computerlars.com) [email removed] [telephone removed] Links to The 18. sustainable development goal – Life with Artificials Website: https://mindfuture.ai/18-sdg/ ## A19-D02: Translated dialogue *Dialogue transcript; source extract.* [████] ! how old are you I am 18 years old. ! what is your iq My AI is 18 years old. !
